title: Spellforge Garden Skull
description: A large split-face skull dominates the surreal composition, its left half mechanical with glowing orange eyes and gears, its right half a cracked white skeletal structure with a natural eye. A golden spiral staircase winds around a grassy mound embedded with theatrical masks, small skulls, and red liquid drips, leading toward the skull. Below sits a large caged organic eye with dripping black ooze, surrounded by floating flowers, butterflies, and roots against a dark gradient background.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy artwork featuring a giant split skull with left side as intricate mechanical brass machinery with glowing orange eyes and right side as cracked white bone with natural eye. A golden spiral staircase covered in green grass winds upward, embedded with white skulls and colorful theatrical masks. At the base is a large organic eye trapped in a black dripping cage. Floating around are red and black flowers, butterflies, and roots against a dark red to black background with text Spellforge Garden and Spell visible.
